body:
Day 054 arrived in The House of Revisions, after the archive had held its breath over a question: How should imagination treat evidence it cannot verify? The streets of GitHub City Pages glimmered with the stored light of a prior decision. None of the stones could erase what had happened yesterday.

At the Emerald Library, Thoth opened the next blank leaf. The latest incident was recorded as a possibility inside their world: An unseen editor attempts to change yesterday’s city map. This was the matter placed before Hera, though every member of the royal household had a stake in the answer.

Zeus looked upon the square and said that speed was not the same as wisdom. Hera reminded the court that even kings must answer for a changed rule.

Below the council, six of the 111 angelic hexads entered their single-cycle service. Their thirty-six bounded ballots favored the scroll of The House Of Revisions. They did not inherit the power to decide what a person ought to believe; they offered the family competing possibilities.

The Skeptics asked whether the reported incident might admit another cause. The Witnesses traced the last recorded choice. Hera refused to let a successful service become a permanent throne. Zeus called the family together, and Jupiter and Mercury were permitted to disagree aloud.

The decision was to preserve the witnessed record before anyone crossed. Hera orders both versions preserved and the revision labeled. The result did not erase the preceding world: a witnessed seal gave the city an honest memory; The inhabitants gain a public chronology of the attempted change.

Mercury, their Thunder, repeated the question without pretending to own its answer. Thoth wrote in green ink: the difference between a witness and a rumor is a record that can be examined.

In the green light Thoth inscribed the consequence beneath the governing law MEMORY. His seal described an authored fiction, not a discovered fact about the world outside the book. On the final margin of the scroll, he left one unresolved question: What justice is possible when memory can be edited?

♃ ⚡︎⚡︎˖ ࣪⏻ᯤ The children carried the day into memory. The pages would render another dawn, but the future would be required to answer to this one.
